We use the email only to send this listing and reply to you. No newsletter.

Who pays — us or the vendor?

Either. Agencies on-charge it like photography in the vendor's marketing budget, or keep it as their own edge at the appraisal.

What if the plan is wrong?

Buyers and you can report a mistake in one line from the walk. We fix it and rebuild at no cost.

Photoreal?

Not in these plans. The walk is to scale with estimated finishes. Photoreal renders are quoted per home when you need them.

Can I take a listing down?

Yes, any time, from the listing's owner controls. It shows "made private at the builder's request".
